storageMap.MOCK_FIXTURE: existing isolated-fixture receipt; never accepted by current-DB acceptance

storageTrust: pinned server transport + verified DB/environment identity; model/fixture cannot choose current label. String enum validation alone is not origin proof.

freshness.read: new READ ONLY repository transaction per tool call; no memory/journal/result cache
freshness.asOf: observedAt at fresh read; within call time and server maxAge 30s
freshness.latestAttemptAt: may be old if no new learning; not confused with observation age
freshness.invalidated: deadline/authority expiry, expected state mismatch, content/scope change, internal inconsistency

auditMode: no persisted Agent Run/Skill Run/tool event; test correlation is not an Agent authority
mandatoryLessonEvidence: Existing Explain requires selected-sentence Lesson Tool evidence. Durable evidence is additional for completion-aware decisions, not a substitute for sentence evidence. Future checker must require exact tool/scope/freshness from private execution ledger, never model-supplied evidence.
planningAudit: studentPlanningContext contains refs/revision/locales only; no authoritative sentence, completion sentence or progress injected; coordinator auto tool choice and mandatory completion guard already present
